text.en: 1. To register the business within 30 days from the date of commencement of the business by submitting the Business Registration Form (Form A).
text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Pendaftaran

Perniagaan (Pindaan) 2014.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 April 2014.

Pindaan kaedah 6

text.en:
2. To renew the registration of business within 30 days before the expiry date of the registration or the prior renewal by submitting the Application for

Renewal of Business Registration Form (Form A1).
text.ms:
2. Kaedah-Kaedah Pendaftaran Perniagaan 1957 [L.N. 282/1957], yang disebut

"Kaedah-Kaedah ibu" dalam Kaedah-Kaedah ini, dipinda dalam subkaedah 6(1) dengan

menggantikan perkataan "Form B1, B2, B3 or B4, as may be relevant," dengan perkataan

"Form B".

Pindaan kaedah 8

text.en:
3. To register any changes in the business particulars within 30 days from the date of the change of the principal business address, type of business,

particulars on branches and information of the owner by submitting the Registration of Changes of Business Particulars Form (Form B).
text.ms:
3. Subkaedah 8(1) Kaedah-Kaedah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan perkataan

"Forms A, B1, B2, B3, B4 and C" dengan perkataan "Forms A, A1, B and C".

Penggantian kaedah 13

text.en:
4. To inform the termination of business within 30 days from the date of termination of the business operation or, if it is due to death, within 4 months

from the date of death by submitting the Notification of Termination of Registered Business Form (Form C).
text.ms:

text.en: 5. To display the Certificate of Registration of Business in a conspicuous place at the main business premises or branch.

6. To put up a signboard displaying the business name and registration number outside the place of business and if there is more than one place of

business, outside each place of business.

7. To display the business name and registration number of the certificate of registration on every business letterhead, invoice, bill or other

document.

8. To duly obtain the licence, permit or approval letter from the relevant authority in relation to the types of businesses which require approval prior to

commencement even if the said business has been registered with the Companies Commission of Malaysia.

Penalty provisions under the Registration of Businesses Act 1956 and Registration of Businesses Rules 1957

1. Contravention of items (1) & (2) shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding RM50,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 2

years or to both.

2. Contravention of items (3), (4), (6) & (7) shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding RM10,000 or to imprisonment for a term not

exceeding 1 year or to both.

3. Contravention of item (5) shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding RM2,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or

to both. ''; dan

RESPONSIBILITY OF BUSINESS OWNER:

1. To register the business within 30 days from the date of commencement of the business by submitting the Business Registration Form (Form A).

2. To renew the registration of business within 30 days before the expiry date of the registration or the prior renewal by submitting the Application for

Renewal of Business Registration Form (Form A1).

3. To register any changes in the business particulars within 30 days from the date of the change of the principal business address, type of business,

particulars on branches and information of the owner by submitting the Registration of Changes of Business Particulars Form (Form B).

4. To inform the termination of business within 30 days from the date of termination of the business operation or, if it is due to death, within 4 months

from the date of death by submitting the Notification of Termination of Registered Business Form (Form C).

5. To display the Certificate of Renewal of Registration of Business in a conspicuous place at the main business premises or branch.

6. To put up a signboard displaying the business name and registration number outside the place of business and if there is more than one place of

business, outside each place of business.

7. To display the business name and registration number of the certificate of renewal of registration on every business letterhead, invoice, bill or

other document.

8. To duly obtain the licence, permit or approval letter from the relevant authority in relation to the types of businesses which require approval prior to

commencement even if the said business has been registered with the Companies Commission of Malaysia.

Penalty provisions under the Registration of Businesses Act 1956 and Registration of Businesses Rules 1957

1. Contravention of items (1) & (2) shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding RM50,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 2

years or to both.

2. Contravention of items (3), (4), (6) & (7) shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding RM10,000 or to imprisonment for a term not

exceeding 1 year or to both.

3. Contravention of item (5) shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding RM2,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or to

both. ''.

Penerusan penggunaan borang

6. Semua borang yang ditetapkan dalam Kaedah-Kaedah ibu yang digunakan sebelum

tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa Kaedah-Kaedah ini boleh terus digunakan bagi tempoh satu

bulan dari tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa Kaedah-Kaedah ini.

Dibuat 21 Mac 2014

DATO' SRI HASAN BIN MALEK

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri, Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

REGISTRATION OF BUSINESSES ACT 1956

REGISTRATION OF BUSINESSES (AMENDMENT) RULES 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 16 of the Registration of Businesses Act

1956 [Act 197], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Registration of Businesses (Amendment)

Rules 2014.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 1 April 2014.

Amendment of rule 6

2. The Registration of Businesses Rules 1957 [L.N. 282/1957], which are referred to as

the "principal Rules" in these Rules, are amended in subrule 6(1) by substituting for the

words "Form B1, B2, B3 or B4, as may be relevant," the words "Form B".

Amendment of rule 8

3. Subrule 8(1) of the principal Rules is amended by substituting for the words

"Forms A, B1, B2, B3, B4 and C" the words "Forms A, A1, B and C".

Substitution of rule 13

4. The principal Rules are amended by substituting for rule 13 the following rule:

"Display of

certificate of

registration,

business

number, etc.

13. (1) A certificate of registration or a certificate of renewal

of registration issued under the Act shall be in Form D or Form E,

as the case may be.

 (2) Every letterhead, invoice, bill or other document

used by a registered business and containing the name or names of

such business shall display the registration number assigned to the

business in the certificate of registration or certificate of renewal of

registration.".
